data.value: Configure PHP runtime limits, including execution timeouts, maximum upload times, etc.

data.name: RuntimeLimitsPageLongDescription
data.value: Configure PHP runtime limits, such as maximum script execution time, maximum size of uploaded files, request timeouts and others.

data.name: RuntimeLimitsMaxExecutionTimeDescription
data.value: Maximum time in seconds a script is allowed to run before it is terminated by the parser. This helps prevent poorly written scripts from tying up the server.

data.name: RuntimeLimitsMaxFileUploadsDescription
data.value: Maximum number of files that can be uploaded via a single request.

data.name: RuntimeLimitsMaxInputTimeDescription
data.value: Maximum time in seconds a script is allowed to parse input data, like POST, GET and file uploads.

data.name: RuntimeLimitsMemoryLimitDescription
data.value: Maximum amount of memory in bytes that a script is allowed to allocate. This helps prevent poorly written scripts for eating up all available memory on a server.

data.name: RuntimeLimitsPostMaxSizeDescription
data.value: Maximum allowed size of POST data. This setting also affects file upload. To upload large files, this value must be larger than upload_max_filesize.

data.name: RuntimeLimitsUploadMaxFilesizeDescription
data.value: Maximum allowed size for uploaded files.

data.name: ConfigIssueCgiForceRedirectNotCorrect
data.value: The PHP directive "cgi.force_redirect" is not set to "0".

data.name: ConfigIssueCgiForceRedirectNotSet
data.value: The PHP directive "cgi.force_redirect" is not set.

data.name: ConfigIssueCgiForceRedirectRecommend
data.value: It is recommended to turn "cgi.force_redirect" off when PHP is run on IIS.

data.name: ConfigIssueCgiPathInfoNotCorrect
data.value: The PHP directive "cgi.fix_pathinfo" is not set to "1".

data.name: ConfigIssueCgiPathInfoNotSet
data.value: The PHP directive "cgi.fix_pathinfo" is not set.

data.name: ConfigIssueCgiPathInfoRecommend
data.value: This setting provides real PATH_INFO/ PATH_TRANSLATED support for CGI and FastCGI. It is recommended to enable this support by setting it to "1".

data.name: ConfigIssueErrorLogNotCorrect
data.value: The PHP directive "error_log" is using a non-existent directory.

data.name: ConfigIssueErrorLogNotSet
data.value: The PHP directive "error_log" is not set.

data.name: ConfigIssueErrorLogRecommend
data.value: The "error_log" specifies the name of the file where script errors should be logged to. It is recommended to set this to an absolute file path and the file should be writable by the web server.

data.name: ConfigIssueExtensionDirIncorrect
data.value: The PHP directive "extension_dir" does not contain an absolute file path.

data.name: ConfigIssueExtensionDirNotSet
data.value: The PHP directive "extension_dir" is not set.

data.name: ConfigIssueExtensionDirRecommend
data.value: The "extension_dir" is used to specify a directory path in which PHP should look for dynamically loadable extensions. It is recommended to use absolute directory path for this setting.

data.name: ConfigIssueFastCgiImpersonateNotCorrect
data.value: The PHP directive "fastcgi.impersonate" is not set to "1".

data.name: ConfigIssueFastCgiImpersonateNotSet
data.value: The PHP directive "fastcgi.impersonate" is not set.

data.name: ConfigIssueFastCgiImpersonateRecommend
data.value: FastCGI supports the ability to impersonate security tokens of the calling client. This allows IIS to define the security context that the request runs under. It is recommended to enable impersonation by setting this directive to "1".

data.name: ConfigIssueLogErrorsNotCorrect
data.value: The PHP directive "log_errors" is not set to "On".

data.name: ConfigIssueLogErrorsNotSet
data.value: The PHP directive "log_errors" is not set.

data.name: ConfigIssueLogErrorsRecommend
data.value: The "log_errors" controls whether PHP logs errors and warning to a log file. It is recommended to set this to "On".

data.name: ConfigIssueMonitorChangesIncorrect
data.value: The FastCGI setting monitorChangesTo is pointing to a wrong file.

data.name: ConfigIssueMonitorChangesNotSet
data.value: The FastCGI setting monitorChangesTo is not set.

data.name: ConfigIssueMonitorChangesRecommend
data.value: The monitorChangesTo setting is used to configure FastCGI to monitor a file so that when file is changed the FastCGI processes are recycled. It is recommended to set this to point to php.ini file that is loaded by PHP. That way the configuration changes to PHP will take effect immediately after the php.ini is updated.

data.name: ConfigIssuePHPMaxRequestsIncorrect
data.value: The value for PHP_FCGI_MAX_REQUESTS is smaller than the value for FastCGI instanceMaxRequests setting.

data.name: ConfigIssuePHPMaxRequestsNotSet
data.value: The environment variable PHP_FCGI_MAX_REQUESTS is not set for PHP processes.

data.name: ConfigIssuePHPMaxRequestsRecommend
data.value: The PHP_FCGI_MAX_REQUESTS environment variable is used to specify the number of requests that PHP executable will handle before it gets recycled. It is recommended that the value for this variable is greater or equal to the value for FastCgi instanceMaxRequests setting. That way the IIS FastCGI process recycling logic will not conflict with PHP recycling behavior.

data.name: ConfigIssuePHPRCFileNotExists
data.value: The PHPRC environment variable points to a directory that does not contain php.ini file.

data.name: ConfigIssuePHPRCNotSet
data.value: The PHPRC environment variable is not set for PHP processes.

data.name: ConfigIssuePHPRCRecommend
data.value: The PHPRC environment variable is used to specify the directory that contains a PHP configuration file php.ini. PHP will load that configuration file during startup. It is recommended to always set this environment variable per PHP registration, thus avoiding situations when PHP loads wrong configuration file.

data.name: ConfigIssueResourceTypeIncorrect
data.value: The resourceType attribute of an IIS handler for PHP is not set to "Either".

data.name: ConfigIssueResourceTypeRecommend
data.value: The IIS handler attribute resourceType is used to specify a condition when handler will be invoked for a web request. When configuring the handler for PHP, it is recommended to set this attribute to "Either" for security reasons. That way the handler will be invoked only if the requested URL maps to a file or a folder on the file system.

data.name: ConfigIssueSessionPathNotCorrect
data.value: The PHP directive "session.save_path" uses a non-existent directory.

data.name: ConfigIssueSessionPathNotSet
data.value: The PHP directive "session.save_path" is not set.

data.name: ConfigIssueSessionPathRecommend
data.value: The "session.save_path" sets the path to the directory where PHP session data will be stored. It is recommended to use an absolute path to the directory that is writable by the web server.

data.name: ConfigIssueDefaultDocumentNotSet
data.value: index.php is not set as a default document.

data.name: ConfigIssueDefaultDocumentRecommend
data.value: Majority of PHP applications use index.php as the default file name for web requests. It is recommended to add index.php to the list of default documents in IIS and ensure that it is the first in the list.

data.name: ConfigIssueDefaultDocumentNotFirst
data.value: index.php is not the first in the list of IIS default documents.
